title: K2 Pictures Announces Gigant Anime, The Book of Human Insects Musical Film
content: The GIGANT anime adaptation marks the studio's first animated feature project. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and it describes the story: Rei Yokoyamada, a high schooler whose father works for a film production company, is inspired to create his own short film with his friends.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Manga Takes 1-Week Break Due to Author's Health
content: The manga took an unplanned one-week break in June last year also due to Hokazono's "sudden illness," and another break in October due to production reasons. Hokazono debuted the Kagurabachi manga in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in September 2023.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer to Return With New Anime Release Ahead of Infinity Castle Part 2
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba is now hard at work on its next major Infinity Castle movie, and has announced it’s coming back with a special anime release to keep the fires burning in the meantime.

title: 5 Action-Packed 2026 Anime Series You’ll Love If You’re a KPop Demon Hunters Fan
content: One of the primary reasons why KPop Demon Hunters became a worldwide hit was its high-octane fantasy action. Featuring the Huntrix taking on demons while also undergoing character development was at the core of the series, something that is consistently reflected through its action sequences.

title: Keanu Reeves to Star in Dwarf Studios' Full-Length Stop-Motion Samurai Film Hidari
content: Japanese stop-motion animation studio dwarf studios announced on Sunday at the Annecy Animation Showcase of the 79th Cannes International Film Festival that actor Keanu Reeves will star as Jingoro Hidari in the studio's HIDARI stop-motion samurai film.

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: Cloudy Beach Anime Film Reveals New Visual, Trailer
content: The staff of the SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: CLOUDY BEACH anime film began streaming a new promotional video for the movie on Sunday. The staff also revealed a new version of the visual previously unveiled in March. The film will again star Chiyuki Miura as Yuuki.

title: 'Yomi no Tsugai' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Yomi no Tsugai ( Daemons of the Shadow Realm ) television anime announced supporting cast pair on Saturday. The anime series adapting Hiromu Arakawa 's action fantasy manga premiered on Tokyo MX, BS11, and other stations at 11:30 p.m. on April 4.
